Setup / preconditions: App server is running; browser available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open http://localhost:3000; 2) wait for the page to finish loading.
Expected result: Product Owner AI account page opens and shows sign-in and account creation options; no browser network error appears.

Setup / preconditions: Use an email address not already registered and a test-only password of at least 8 characters.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) On the account page, enter a name, email, and password under Create an account; 2) click Create account.
Expected result: A success message appears and the browser opens the profile page signed in as the new user.

Setup / preconditions: Use a new test email address.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) On the account page, enter a name and email; 2) enter a password shorter than 8 characters; 3) click Create account.
Expected result: The browser blocks submission or shows a clear validation error; no account is created.

Setup / preconditions: A test account already exists; sign out first if currently signed in.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Enter the test account email and an incorrect password under Use email and password; 2) click Sign in.
Expected result: Sign-in is rejected with a readable error; the user remains signed out.

Test case: Sign in with email and password
Setup / preconditions: A test account exists.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Enter the correct test email and password; 2) click Sign in.
Expected result: The user is signed in and redirected to Profile & integrations; their name/email are shown.

Test case: Sign out and return to sign-in
Setup / preconditions: A test account is signed in.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open http://localhost:3000; 2) click Sign out; 3) refresh the page.
Expected result: The account is signed out; sign-in/create-account options appear and protected profile data is not shown.

Setup / preconditions: Google OAuth client credentials and the local callback URL are configured in the app environment.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) On the account page, click Sign in with Google; 2) complete the Google consent/sign-in flow.
Expected result: Google returns to the app, signs the user in, and a private workspace is available.

Setup / preconditions: Atlassian OAuth client credentials and local callback are configured.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) On the account page, click Sign in with Atlassian; 2) complete the Atlassian sign-in flow.
Expected result: Atlassian returns to the app, signs the user in, and a private workspace is available.

Setup / preconditions: No active signed-in browser session.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open http://localhost:3000/profile.html.
Expected result: The page explains that sign-in is required and offers a link back to sign-in; credential forms are not available.

Setup / preconditions: A test account is signed in; use fake placeholder values, never a real API token.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open Profile & integrations; 2) in the Jira card, enter a placeholder URL, email, and fake token; 3) click Save credentials.
Expected result: A saved confirmation appears; the secret field is cleared or shown as saved securely, not displayed as the fake secret.

Test case: Keep a saved secret when editing non-secret settings
Setup / preconditions: TC-010 completed.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Refresh the profile page; 2) confirm the saved-secret hint is shown; 3) update a non-secret Jira field and leave the secret blank; 4) click Save credentials; 5) refresh again.
Expected result: The non-secret field update is retained and the saved secret remains configured without being revealed.

Setup / preconditions: A fake test credential exists from TC-010.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the Jira card, click Delete; 2) refresh the profile page.
Expected result: A removal confirmation appears and the Jira test credential is no longer configured.

Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in; extension is installed and pointed at localhost.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open the Product Owner AI extension from the Chrome toolbar; 2) under Account and workspace enter a workspace name; 3) click Create workspace; 4) select the new workspace in Switch workspace.
Expected result: The new workspace appears in the selector and becomes the active workspace; its projects and context are separate from other workspaces.

Setup / preconditions: A Company Admin is signed in; a second test account/email is available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the extension under Account and workspace, enter the teammate email (optional); 2) click Create invite link; 3) copy the generated token; 4) sign in as the invited test user, paste the token into Accept a workspace invite, and click Join workspace.
Expected result: The invite is created and the second account can join the invited workspace; a different email is rejected if the invite is email-restricted.

Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in to the extension.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the extension, paste a few test requirements into Paste project documentation or a meeting transcript; 2) enter a project name; 3) click Create project from notes; 4) select the new project.
Expected result: The project is added to the Project list and the stored context/notes are available when selected.

Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in and has a project selected; a small non-sensitive .txt or .md test file is available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the extension, use Add text documents or exported transcripts; 2) choose the test file; 3) follow the UI upload action/status if shown; 4) refresh/select the project again.
Expected result: The file is accepted and its text is added to the selected project's context; invalid or oversized files show an error rather than a success message.

Setup / preconditions: AI billing is configured and has a valid test key/credits; a project or sample requirements are available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the extension, select a project or paste sample requirements; 2) click Generate project pack; 3) wait for completion.
Expected result: A project summary and generated sections appear, including user stories, a diagram, test cases, product documentation, roadmap, and risks.
Status: Blocked until a working AI billing/key is configured

Test case: Ask a question about the project
Setup / preconditions: TC-017 succeeded and project context remains available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In Ask about this project, enter a question about a requirement in the sample; 2) click Ask product agent.
Expected result: An answer related to the supplied project context appears; errors are visible if AI credentials/credits are unavailable.
Status: Blocked until a working AI billing/key is configured

Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in and has project context; AI billing is configured.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In Meeting agenda draft, select a trigger; 2) click Draft agenda.
Expected result: A proposed agenda appears for review; no meeting is scheduled merely by drafting it.
Status: Blocked until a working AI billing/key is configured

Setup / preconditions: The extension is open; AI billing is configured.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Enter a test member name, yesterday's work, today's plan, and blockers; 2) click Draft stand-up update.
Expected result: A readable stand-up update is generated from the supplied fields.
Status: Blocked until a working AI billing/key is configured

Setup / preconditions: A project pack has been generated; a user is signed in.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Click Export Excel in the extension; 2) choose where to save the download.
Expected result: An Excel file downloads and opens with the generated project sections in a usable format.

Test case: Check role controls for Company Admin
Setup / preconditions: Sign in with a Company Admin account that has at least one other organization member.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open the account page; 2) find Organization roles; 3) choose another member's role; 4) click Update role; 5) sign in as that member and reopen the account page.
Expected result: The selected role is saved; the member sees only the controls their role permits. Company Admin controls remain available only to Company Admins.

Test case: Check role controls for a non-admin
Setup / preconditions: Sign in with Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Head of Product (not Company Admin).
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open the account page; 2) inspect organization role controls; 3) in the extension try an action restricted to Company Admin, if visible.
Expected result: A non-admin cannot assign organization roles or perform Company Admin-only actions; the app shows a clear denial or hides the controls.

Setup / preconditions: Atlassian integration is configured; a Jira test site/account and permission are available.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) In the extension or account screen click Connect Jira / Confluence; 2) authorize; 3) choose a Jira site; 4) click Refresh Jira issues.
Expected result: The connected site and authorized issues appear. Without configured OAuth/provider access, the UI should report that connection is unavailable.

Setup / preconditions: Google OAuth/Drive scopes are configured and a test document is accessible.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Connect Google Drive; 2) in the extension search Drive file names; 3) choose/import a harmless test document.
Expected result: Search results show accessible files and the selected content is added to the current project context.

Setup / preconditions: Atlassian integration is configured and has access to a test space.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Connect Jira / Confluence; 2) enter a distinctive test term under Confluence search; 3) click Search Confluence.
Expected result: Matching authorized pages are listed; unrelated or unauthorized content is not shown.

Setup / preconditions: Slack app, HTTPS event URL, and bot scopes are configured; use a test Slack workspace.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Connect Slack; 2) in extension click Load Slack team members; 3) choose test members; 4) set a time/timezone; 5) optionally enter a test Jira issue; 6) click Schedule daily Slack check-ins.
Expected result: A schedule confirmation appears and the saved schedule is visible; test replies are recorded, and Jira comments are posted only when explicitly configured.
Status: Blocked without Slack app and webhook setup

Setup / preconditions: Zoom OAuth is configured with access to a test cloud recording/transcript.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Connect Zoom; 2) set a date range; 3) click Find Zoom transcripts; 4) select/import a test transcript.
Expected result: Authorized recordings in the chosen date range are listed and selected transcript text is added to project context.
Status: Blocked without Zoom setup and transcript permission

Setup / preconditions: Microsoft Entra app is configured with transcript permissions and a test online meeting transcript exists.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Connect Microsoft Teams; 2) enter the test online meeting ID; 3) click Find Teams transcripts; 4) select/import the transcript.
Expected result: The authorized transcript is listed and its text is added to project context; permission/licensing limitations are clearly reported.
Status: Blocked without Microsoft tenant consent and transcript access

Test case: Review usage and current billing mode
Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in; for administrator-only controls, sign in as Company Admin.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Open the account page; 2) note the displayed billing mode and token usage; 3) as Company Admin, inspect available credits and billing mode controls.
Expected result: The UI shows the current billing path and usage; billing controls are available to Company Admin and not to unauthorized roles.

Test case: Switch between managed credits and BYOK
Setup / preconditions: Company Admin is signed in; billing configuration is available; do not purchase unless using Stripe test mode.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Under AI billing choose a different active billing path; 2) click Save billing path; 3) refresh the page.
Expected result: The selected mode is saved and displayed; generation in managed mode enforces available credits, and BYOK generation requires an active BYOK plan and saved/request-scoped OpenAI key.

Test case: Purchase credits or BYOK subscription in test mode
Setup / preconditions: Stripe test keys, test products/prices, and test webhook endpoint are configured.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Click Buy managed API credits or Subscribe to BYOK; 2) complete checkout using Stripe test details; 3) return to the app.
Expected result: Checkout succeeds in Stripe test mode and the app reflects the resulting credit balance/subscription; repeating a webhook event does not apply the purchase twice.

Setup / preconditions: Two test users/workspaces are available and each has a distinct project.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Sign in as user A and note their project; 2) sign out; 3) sign in as user B; 4) inspect project list and try opening user A's project if an old link is available.
Expected result: User B cannot see or access user A's private workspace project or documents.

Setup / preconditions: A user is signed in and profile or account is open.
Steps to perform in the UI: 1) Sign out; 2) in the same browser tab open or reload /profile.html; 3) try navigating back to the signed-in screen.
Expected result: The app asks the user to sign in again and does not expose profile credentials or protected workspace data.
